verses.html: A Psalm of David. I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.
verses.text: A Psalm of David. I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.
verses.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.html: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
verses.text: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

verses.html: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
verses.text: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

verses.html: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
verses.text: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.

verses.html: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
verses.text: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

verses.html: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
verses.text: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

verses.html: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
verses.text: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

verses.html: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
verses.text: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
